checks.check: H1: the handle's key set does not grow for this slice
H2: the slice is main-only, so no child pays for it
H3: the state stays in closure-owned maps, not on the signal

[system] F2: onabort is called, and reads back as a function
[system] R1a: the signal is an EventTarget
[system] R1b: abort fires once, and a second abort is inert
[system] R1c: the page's own abort dispatches where it was called
[system] R1d: an abort listener's exception stays local

[system] D1: timeout stays absent, as the deferred candidate

[system] L5c: abort still removes the listener
[system] L5d: and aborted is still not writable by a page

limitations: design-frozen court: it fails until R1 through R5 exist
timeout() is pinned absent by ruling, so taking it later amends this court rather than slipping past it
three criteria read the shipped sources beside this court rather than the binary, so they are repo-local by design

the main-only slack and the M1/M2 floors are measured by the shim-footprint and child-frame courts on the same binary; H2 is what keeps this slice out of the base, which is what protects the child floors
